system.description: For as long as you maintain Focus on Birdbite, the target of your Hovering Foe effect takes XD10 damage at the start of their turn, where X is equal to half your Proficiency (rounded up). There is no Trait Check against this effect. If an enemy successfully uses Make Trait Check against Hovering Foe while you also have Focus on Birdbite, you drop Focus on Birdbite instead.
